This app runs ONNX Runtime Web 1.30.0 (https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime, MIT, LICENSE-onnxruntime), with
WebGPU binaries rebuilt from it with a few patches (https://github.com/mdanyalmalik/onnxruntime-web-kernels, MIT,
LICENSE-patches). Its third-party components are listed in ThirdPartyNotices.txt.
